```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Divider color forms complete rows and columns.
    div_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0]
    sep = grid[div_rows[0]][0]
    row_bounds = [-1] + div_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + div_cols + [w]

    counts = []
    for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        line = []
        for j in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            cells = [
                grid[r][c]
                for r in range(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1])
                for c in range(col_bounds[j] + 1, col_bounds[j + 1])
            ]
            line.append(sum(v != 0 and v != sep for v in cells))
        counts.append(line)

    peak = max(max(row) for row in counts)
    return [[1 if count == peak and peak > 1 else sep for count in row] for row in counts]
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0]
    separator = grid[sep_rows[0]][0]

    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    panels = []
    for i in range(len(rb) - 1):
        panel_row = []
        for j in range(len(cb) - 1):
            panel_row.append([
                grid[r][c]
                for r in range(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1])
                for c in range(cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1])
            ])
        panels.append(panel_row)

    # The repeated symbol is the panel background; the anomalous panel
    # contains a different number of the sparse symbol.
    from collections import Counter
    all_cells = [v for row in panels for panel in row for v in panel if v != separator and v != 0]
    background = Counter(all_cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sparse = next((v for v in set(all_cells) if v != background), None)

    counts = [[sum(v == sparse for v in panel) for panel in row] for row in panels]
    mode = Counter(v for row in counts for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [
        [1 if counts[i][j] != mode else background for j in range(len(counts[i]))]
        for i in range(len(counts))
    ]
```

```python
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]

                grid[r][c]
                for r in range(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1])
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(
        grid[r][0] for r in range(h)
        if all(x == grid[r][0] for x in grid[r]) and grid[r][0] != 0
    )
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]

    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    result = []
    for i in range(len(rb) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cb) - 1):
            cells = [
                grid[r][c]
                for r in range(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1])
                for c in range(cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1])
            ]
            # Each compartment has a common object color; mark those with
            # multiple instances of that object.
            vals = [v for v in cells if v not in (0, sep)]
            from collections import Counter
            counts = Counter(vals)
            row.append(1 if max(counts.values(), default=0) > 1 else sep)
        result.append(row)
    return result
```

```python
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep = grid[sep_rows[0]][0]

    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rb) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cb) - 1):
            cells = [
                grid[r][c]
                for r in range(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1])
```
